spoken_summary: An off-camera voice (identified in context as a White House official, likely the President) introduces Mullin: "We're thrilled to swear in our new Secretary of Homeland Security, a great American patriot, to put it mildly, Mark Wayne Mullin. There's one man for this job, and I have no doubt he's going to be fantastic." Mullin then speaks: "I don't care what color your state is. I don't care if you're red or you're blue. At the end of the day, my job is to be Secretary of Homeland and to protect everybody the same, and we will do that. No one's going to outwork me. The president has entrusted me with this, and failure is not an option. And so thank you so much, Mr. President, for this opportunity. I won't let you down."
